author: bardic-inspiration
name: Farrier's Tools
summary: Hoof knives, rasps, and shoeing hammers for keeping mounts and draft animals sound on the road.
description: Every cavalry stable and caravan master keeps a farrier, and a farrier is rarely far from their roll of well-worn tools. A set includes a hoof pick, rasp, nippers, a driving hammer, and a few pounds of nails.

tool.utilize: Shoe a mount or other hooved animal (DC 10), or find the cause of a mount's lameness (DC 15)
